newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil 1996 unemployment up at 5.42 pct - IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil 1996 unemployment up at 5.42 pct - IBGE.

text.p: Brazil's 1996 unemployment rate increased to 5.42 percent from 4.64 percent in 1995, the National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.
However, the IBGE said the trend was toward a fall in the unemployment rate given that the growth in unemployment slowed in the last few months of 1996.

The number of people out of work rose in all urban areas of Brazil with the highest unemployment rate of 6.83 percent in Salvador followed by 6.28 percent in Sao Paulo. Rio de Janeiro recorded the lowest rate at 3.65 percent.
The number of people employed increased 2.2 percent in 1996 in comparison with the previous year, especially in the construction, retail and service sectors, the IBGE said.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
